name: sos_rate_limiting
description: SOS emergency rate limiting per spec Section 18.3. 10min cooldown, 3/hr max, burst 2.

vectors.name: first_sos_accepted
vectors.description: First SOS from a node is always accepted immediately.

vectors.name: burst_second_accepted
vectors.description: Second SOS within burst window (2 allowed) is accepted.

vectors.name: third_before_cooldown_rejected
vectors.description: Third SOS before 10min cooldown is rejected.

vectors.name: third_after_cooldown_accepted
vectors.description: Third SOS after 10min cooldown is accepted (within hourly limit).

vectors.name: fourth_in_hour_rejected
vectors.description: Fourth SOS in same hour is rejected (3/hr max).

vectors.name: hourly_window_slides
vectors.description: Old SOS outside 1-hour window no longer counts; recent ones do.

vectors.name: monotonic_uptime_enforced
vectors.description: Rate limiting uses monotonic uptime, not wall clock.

vectors.name: different_nodes_independent
vectors.description: Different sender IIDs have independent rate limits.

vectors.name: cooldown_resets_on_accept
vectors.description: Successful SOS resets the 10min cooldown timer.

vectors.name: sos_clears_confessions_rate
vectors.description: SOS does NOT share rate limit with confessions (independent).
